scope: Official npm production audit and exact-lock freshness for the 2026-10-10 monthly dependency refresh and baseline renewal; not runtime/release/UAT evidence

release_age_review.reason: pnpm 9 has no minimum release age, and a monthly in-range update locks versions published only hours earlier; a freshly published version is the usual entry point of a compromised maintainer account.
release_age_review.method: Registry publish time of every newly locked version; for versions published at or after 2026-10-06T00:00:00Z (UTC), versions whose publish time could not be read on the first fetch, and the four override bumps: npm provenance attestations (dist.attestations), the publishing account compared with the preceding versions, and install scripts.

publisher_change.accepted_because: puppeteer-core 25.13.0, itself published with provenance, pins this exact version; chromium-bidi's source moved into Chromium (third_party/chromium-bidi) and its versions now follow Chrome; chrome-devtools-npm is a listed maintainer next to mathias and google-wombot; no install scripts.

full_audit.note: Both were already open on main (Dependabot alerts 80 and 118): faker only in the Prism mock chain, braces with no patched release. The undici 7.29.0 that nx 23.3.0 pins exactly is overridden to 7.30.0 with the range selector undici@>=7.0.0 <7.29.1; pnpm applies it to every declared range that intersects the selector, so the production @ai-sdk/provider-utils (^7.29.0) is held at the same 7.30.0. A parent-scoped nx>undici key is not admitted by the dependency source policy.
